phrases.latin: Olīvās lūmināria autoraedae aliam post aliam ē tenebrīs ēdūcēbant.
phrases.english: The headlights brought the olive trees out of the dark one after another.
phrases.source: Libellus II, Sintra: castellum et puteus

phrases.english: to turn on (turn off) the bright (dim) lights

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 216, 326.
